title: Pure Ancient Warriors
summary: Ancient Warriors cards only, with generic Rank 4s, Links and staples. Ancient Warriors are WIND, WATER, FIRE and DARK Beast-Warriors inspired by Romance of the Three Kingdoms that send their own Ancient Warriors Saga Continuous Spells/Traps to the GY to swarm, bounce, and break boards.

summary.title: Starters
points: Ancient Warriors Saga - Three Visits searches a different Ancient Warriors monster whenever you Normal or Special Summon an Ancient Warriors monster, and Special Summons an Ancient Warriors monster from the hand when sent from the Spell & Trap Zone to the GY.

Ancient Warriors - Masterful Sun Mou sends a card from your hand or field to the GY (such as Three Visits) to search any Ancient Warriors monster, and bounces an opposing monster whenever another Ancient Warriors monster's effect activates.
Ancient Warriors - Savage Don Ying searches a Level 7+ Ancient Warriors monster or an Ancient Warriors Continuous Spell/Trap on Normal or Special Summon.

summary.title: Opening: Masterful Sun Mou + Three Visits
steps: Activate Ancient Warriors Saga - Three Visits, then Normal Summon Ancient Warriors - Masterful Sun Mou; Three Visits triggers to search Ancient Warriors - Ingenious Zhuge Kong, which immediately Special Summons itself from the hand.
Send Three Visits to the GY as cost for Sun Mou to search Ancient Warriors - Savage Don Ying (or Rebellious Lu Feng); Three Visits' GY effect then Special Summons Don Ying from the hand.

Don Ying searches Ancient Warriors Saga - Deception and Betrayal (or a Level 7+ boss), and two WIND Beast-Warriors Link Summon Ancient Warriors Oath - Double Dragon Lords to search another Ancient Warriors card.

summary.title: Going Second & Saga Synergy
summary.text: When the opponent controls monsters, Ancient Warriors - Loyal Guan Yun Special Summons itself for free, and Ancient Warriors - Virtuous Liu Xuan sends a card to Special Summon an Ancient Warriors monster straight from the Deck. Ancient Warriors - Graceful Zhou Gong sends a Continuous Spell/Trap you control to the GY to add an Ancient Warriors Spell/Trap from the Deck, triggering the sent Saga's graveyard effect at the same time.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Ancient Warriors Oath - Double Dragon Lords (Link-2) searches any Ancient Warriors card on Link Summon, boosts all Ancient Warriors by 500 ATK/DEF, and sends a card from your hand or field to the GY as a Quick Effect to bounce any face-up card the opponent controls.

Ancient Warriors - Rebellious Lu Feng Special Summons itself while you control the highest-ATK Ancient Warriors monster on the field, and destroys the opponent's highest-ATK monster during either Main Phase.

Ancient Warriors - Savage Don Ying forces the opponent to pay 400 LP to activate cards or effects while you control a Level 7+ Ancient Warriors monster, and banishes a card from the opponent's GY to draw a card whenever a monster is sent there.
Ancient Warriors - Ingenious Zhuge Kong tributes a Continuous Saga to negate a Spell/Trap activation, or tributes itself while Sun Mou is out to negate a monster effect.

summary.title: Sagas
points: Ancient Warriors Saga - Deception and Betrayal Special Summons an Ancient Warriors monster from the hand by paying LP equal to its Level x 100, and sends itself to the GY to change an Ancient Warriors' Attribute or steal an opposing Ancient Warriors monster.

Ancient Warriors Saga - Sun-Liu Alliance locks out an Attribute's monster effects while you control two or more Attributes of Ancient Warriors, and Defense of Changban stops opposing Spell/Trap activations when your Ancient Warriors battle.
